question: Compute the average unemployment rate increase (from 1995 to 1996) across districts that satisfy both: (1) have at least one account with monthly issuance ('POPLATEK MESICNE') that made a credit card withdrawal ('VYBER KARTOU') resulting in a negative balance, and (2) have at least one transaction (from any account in the district) with partner bank 'AB'.

measures.multiplicity_argument: One row per district, no duplication from eligibility subqueries

arguments.sql:
SELECT AVG(d.XCL_029 - d.XCL_028) AS avg_unemployment_increase
FROM district AS d
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM account AS a
    JOIN disp AS disp1 ON a.XCL_001 = disp1.XCL_015
    JOIN card AS c ON disp1.XCL_013 = c.XCL_006
    JOIN trans AS t1 ON a.XCL_001 = t1.XCL_047
    WHERE a.XCL_002 = d.XCL_017
      AND a.XCL_003 = 'POPLATEK MESICNE'
      AND t1.XCL_050 = 'VYBER KARTOU'
      AND t1.XCL_052 < 0
)
AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM account AS a2
    JOIN trans AS t2 ON a2.XCL_001 = t2.XCL_047
    WHERE a2.XCL_002 = d.XCL_017
      AND t2.XCL_054 = 'AB'
)

SELECT AVG(d.XCL_029 - d.XCL_028) AS avg_unemployment_increase
FROM district AS d
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM account AS a
    JOIN disp AS disp1 ON a.XCL_001 = disp1.XCL_015
    JOIN card AS c ON disp1.XCL_013 = c.XCL_006
    JOIN trans AS t1 ON a.XCL_001 = t1.XCL_047
    WHERE a.XCL_002 = d.XCL_017
      AND a.XCL_003 = 'POPLATEK MESICNE'
      AND t1.XCL_050 = 'VYBER KARTOU'
      AND t1.XCL_052 < 0
)
AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM account AS a2
    JOIN trans AS t2 ON a2.XCL_001 = t2.XCL_047
    WHERE a2.XCL_002 = d.XCL_017
      AND t2.XCL_054 = 'AB'
)

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
SELECT AVG(d.XCL_029 - d.XCL_028) AS avg_unemployment_increase
FROM district d
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM account a
    JOIN disp disp1 ON a.XCL_001 = disp1.XCL_015
    JOIN card c ON disp1.XCL_013 = c.XCL_006
    JOIN trans t1 ON a.XCL_001 = t1.XCL_047
    WHERE a.XCL_002 = d.XCL_017
      AND a.XCL_003 = 'POPLATEK MESICNE'
      AND t1.XCL_050 = 'VYBER KARTOU'
      AND t1.XCL_052 < 0
)
AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM account a2
    JOIN trans t2 ON a2.XCL_001 = t2.XCL_047
    WHERE a2.XCL_002 = d.XCL_017
      AND t2.XCL_054 = 'AB'
)
